THE CONTROLLER BEHIND THE GAMEPLAY

HOW I PLAY

A few sips.
A few puffs.
A whole lot of possibility.

I use my mouth to move the joystick, sip and puff to activate commands, and my bottom lip to use the lip control. Every game gets a setup that works for me.
